head.title: What we build in MVP, V1 and V2
head.subtitle: See what each version contains, when it counts as done, and what waits for later.

state.label: from WORKPLAN.md and PRD §5 · nothing built yet

head.tldr: Four steps: **Setup** (empty shell + Firebase dev), **MVP** (daily loop for one dish per meal, internal builds), **V1** (first public app: week plan, grocery, pantry, multi-dish meals), **V2** (thali, regions, festivals, stats, family, paid). The meal data model is final from MVP, so later versions add screens, not migrations.

sections.title: The four versions
sections.lead: Each version must meet its exit criteria before the next one starts; open a node to see its workstreams.

sections.title: MVP: the daily loop on one device
sections.lead: MVP plans, cooks and tracks today's meals with one dish per slot; there's no week view, grocery list or pantry.

sections.title: V1: the first public product
sections.lead: V1 turns the daily loop into a planner, diary and kirana list and ships to both stores.

sections.title: V2: depth after launch
sections.lead: V2 starts only once V1 is in stores; it adds screens on the V1 data, not a new meal model.

sections.title: Content runs alongside every version
sections.lead: Recipes, photos and Marathi review are the biggest schedule risk, so they start at Setup.

sections.title: Build order
sections.lead: Work top to bottom; the content workstream runs in parallel.

nodes.label: Setup
nodes.md: Repo, Firebase dev project, design tokens, empty shell. **Exit:** the app builds and runs on a device, signed in anonymously, with the bundled catalog loading.

nodes.label: MVP
nodes.md: **Exit:** a guest on a real device onboards, searches recipes, puts one dish on today, Cook Now → Mark Cooked/Eaten, sees history, and links Google/Apple without losing data.

nodes.label: V1
nodes.md: **Exit:** PRD acceptance loops A–E pass: plan and eat, pantry, grocery integrity, diary without catalog, auth keeps data.

nodes.label: V2
nodes.md: Depth on top of the V1 data model. Order follows product priority; thali and collections are the natural next step.

Recipes from first launch; edits show instantly and sync later

UI for the optional nutrition fields
